theme: Graphite GPU backend and Vulkan Silk.NET
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and the Vulkan Silk.NET package.
highlights_body: This preview adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Android and Linux Vulkan test coverage, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and fixes several native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is upgraded to chrome/m152, with follow-up servicing syncs and stability fixes merged in during the preview.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn
bullets.detail: Adds SkiaSharp bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend, covering Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, alongside a restored SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Android and Linux Vulkan test coverage.
SKImage and SKSurface gain a RequestReadPixels API that works asynchronously across GPU backends.
The published NuGet package READMEs are refreshed with clearer content.

bullets.lead: Several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, an undisposed SKStreamAsset leak in HarfBuzz blob conversion, a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on SKImage.Create failure, and a missed Dispose of the previous uniform buffer in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset().

bullets.lead: FreeType used for Nano Server font support
bullets.detail: Nano Server containers now resolve fonts through FreeType instead of failing due to missing platform font APIs.

bullets.lead: Further managed performance ports and allocation reductions
bullets.detail: SKData.SaveTo, SKFourByteTag/Tag ToString, GetEncodedText, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookups all avoid extra copies, boxing, or allocations, and HandleDictionary's skip-registration check is cached — no observable behaviour change.

bullets.lead: Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android builds
bullets.detail: Apple native symbol packages are generated during pack, Android builds run on Linux with a deterministic build identity requirement, and all solutions are converted to the newer .slnx format.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with the Skia m152 update, Graphite GPU backend bindings, the restored Vulkan Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape and improves NuGet package documentation, alongside the bundled HarfBuzz update to 14.2.1.200.
